posts.title: When the Influencer's Claims Are Stronger Than the Evidence

That’s a bold, hopeful claim based on an observational study of over 12,000 people. And I think she means well. But how true is it?
posts.dek: Vitamin D has real biology behind it. That does not mean the dementia claim is as strong as the clip makes it sound.
